title: Maeterlinck's 'The Cloud That Lifted' foretells the Kennedy assassination

tellings.quote: Because the same guy who wrote that wrote a play called The Cloud That Lifted.

plain: The author and researcher Peter Levenda says that a play called The Cloud That Lifted, by the Belgian writer Maurice Maeterlinck, seems to foretell the 1963 killing of President Kennedy in Dallas, and that its story touches Lee Harvey Oswald, the man accused of the shooting. Levenda links it to the same writer's better-known work The Blue Bird, saying "the same guy who wrote that wrote a play called The Cloud That Lifted," and he tells it as his own summary without naming a source. If true, it would mean a writer saw the event in advance.
